name: Aksharantar (AI4Bharat), Assamese
licence_source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ai4bharat/Aksharantar/raw/main/README.md (Licensing Information, read 2026-11-06): "Manually collected data: Released under CC-BY license. Mined dataset (from Samanantar and IndicCorp): Released under CC0 license. Existing sources: Released under CC0 license." Same terms as the Malayalam file (aksharantar.json); the same source filter is applied.
attribution: Aksharantar by AI4Bharat (Madhani et al., 2022), CC BY and CC0. Includes names from Wikidata (CC0).
verdict_reason: The Assamese files have no 'Dakshina Dataset' or 'Existing sources' rows (Dakshina has no Assamese), so every row is mined (IndicCorp, Samanantar: CC0), Wikidata (CC0) or AI4Bharat's manual collection (AK-Uni, AK-Freq, AK-NEI, AK-NEF: CC BY). The filter in training/mlkb/data/human.py would drop Dakshina and Existing rows if a later release added them.
used_for: asm_train.json rows (IndicCorp with mining score >= -0.2, Samanantar, Wikidata) as transliterator training pairs for packs/as.neopack, and to fit and check the romanised Assamese tables (data/langs/as/romanisation.json). asm_valid.json manual rows (AK-Uni, AK-Freq) validate training. asm_test.json (AK-Freq, AK-NEI, AK-NEF, all manual, CC BY) is the held-out eval set: its words are left out of every training pair.
notes: Fetched 2026-11-06. Extract with: unzip asm.zip -d data/raw/aksharantar-asm/extracted (data/build-as-text.sh does). asm_train.json has 178,630 rows: IndicCorp 177,393, Samanantar 814, Wikidata 423. asm_valid.json 3,788: IndicCorp 1,959, AK-Uni 963, AK-Freq 836, Samanantar 20, Wikidata 10. asm_test.json 5,506: AK-Freq 3,629, AK-NEI 1,134, AK-NEF 743. The CC0 statement says 'We do not own any of the text from which this data has been extracted': mined pairs are single words, which we treat as unprotectable on their own.
